title: Charge orders before completion
description: charge returns false for declines and commits successful charges. mark_complete can fail. Failed work is retried.
diff:
diff --git a/worker.py b/worker.py
--- a/worker.py
+++ b/worker.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 def process(order):
+    charge(order)
     mark_complete(order)

gold_findings.summary: A retry can charge an order twice after mark_complete fails.
gold_findings.minimal_context: charge commits before mark_complete, and failed work is retried.

gold_findings.summary: A declined charge still marks the order complete.
gold_findings.minimal_context: charge returns false for a declined payment, but process ignores its result.
